data.name: Azfer
data.long_meaning: The name Azfer is derived from the Arabic root 'azafara' which means 'to guard, protect, defend'. This name is commonly given to boys who are believed to have strong character, courage, and the ability to protect and defend those around them. It is also a name for those who have triumphed over adversity and are victorious in life.
data.spiritual_meaning: Protection and defense from evil, God's guidance and support
data.numerology_meaning: The name Azfer is a 2 Life Path Number name. Individuals with this number are often very diplomatic, and they hate conflict. They are gentle, friendly, and they love to help others. They are also very sensitive, and they often feel things deeply.

in_arabic.name: عزفر
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من عزف و فر، يعني بالغ في العزف
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عزفر مشتق من الجذرين عزف و فر، و يعني الشخص الذي يبالغ في العزف، و قد ورد في بعض الآثار أن العزف هو الرفع و الارتفاع، فعزفر قد يكون الشخص ذو الرفعة و العلو في العزف و الفنون

in_urdu.name: عزفر
